policy.name: Thirteenth Malaysia Plan (RMK13)
policy.indicator: public transport modal share across modes

limitations: Observed counts describe trips published in this local tap-in/tap-out OD snapshot. Source-internal reconciliation is exact where reported and does not establish capture of every underlying journey.

Destination coverage is asymmetric. The published destination roster has substantially fewer Putrajaya Line codes than the origin roster. An absent OD pair is outside the observed roster, with no zero or trip estimate assigned.

Separate source origin codes at the same physical facility remain separate categories of published activity. The diagnostic checks for identical daily series. Transaction-level evidence would be needed to test partial overlap or transfer counting.
KTM, ERL, BRT and other modes are outside the Rapid Rail scope. Station-origin trips can include travellers from other districts, repeated trips by one person and transfers recorded by the source.

Per-resident figures scale origins by district population. Per-station figures are district averages over physical facilities. Neither metric measures congestion, walking access, resident modal share or unmet demand.

The historical Step 4 and 4B research used PLANMalaysia polygons. This publication independently assigns the GTFS points using the pinned OpenStreetMap polygons, then recomputes district activity, coverage and screening. Counts and classes agree with the archived results. Distance diagnostics are approximate and refer to the OpenStreetMap edges.

Station densities count GTFS-linked infrastructure divided by whole-district residents. Station footprints, walking distance, first- and last-mile connections, feeder bus coverage and frequency, fare affordability, and passenger residential locations were unmeasured.
A station-origin trip is attributed to the origin station's district. Transfers and travel across district boundaries prevent treating these trips as resident travel behaviour.
Coverage is specific to Rapid Rail LRT, MRT and Monorail in the local timetable. KTM, ERL, BRT, planned stations, and other bus services are outside these counts.
Station point assignments are conditional on this GTFS feed and the dates and precision of the recovered boundary snapshot. Close-to-edge stop coordinates warrant care in district interpretation.
Household survey point estimates and whole-district aggregates can mask pockets of vulnerability within station catchments. Sampling uncertainty is unavailable in the supplied extracts.
A district screening flag is a descriptive priority for follow-up. Evidence of unmet demand would require catchment, access and household travel information.
physicalDeduplication: Shared trunk records and documented integrated interchange facilities are grouped. Separate structures connected by public walks retain separate station IDs.
scope: Eight whole administrative units used as a district proxy for districts referenced in the PLANMalaysia National Conurbation glossary. The planning extent encompasses parts of Selangor; whole districts enable consistent joins and denominators.
